description: This file defines the MediaPlayerDemo activity, which provides a UI with buttons to play local or streamed audio and video media. It sets up click listeners for different media types and launches corresponding media activities.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo
classes.description: An Android activity that provides buttons to launch media playback activities for local and streaming audio and video.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds button click listeners for media controls.

methods.name: mLocalAudioListener
methods.description: Click listener to launch the local audio media activity.

methods.name: mResourcesAudioListener
methods.description: Click listener to launch the resources audio media activity.

methods.name: mLocalVideoListener
methods.description: Click listener to launch the local video media activity.

methods.name: mStreamVideoListener
methods.description: Click listener to launch the streaming video media activity.
